package sandbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type SandboxCreator struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

// NewSandboxCreator builds the canonical HTTP sandbox creation client for the
// target architecture.
func NewSandboxCreator(baseURL, internalToken string) *SandboxCreator {
	return &SandboxCreator{
		BaseURL:       strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/"),
		InternalToken: internalToken,
		HTTPClient:    &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second},
	}
}

// CreateSandbox creates a sandbox via the canonical HTTP-owned path.
func (c *SandboxCreator) CreateSandbox(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string, composeConfig []byte, codeStructureTypeCode string, codeStructure []byte, starterFileStorageID string) (string, string, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.BaseURL) == "" {
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("sandbox base url is empty")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(userID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(taskID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(answerID) == "" {
		return "", "", domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(composeConfig)) == 0 {
		return "", "", domain.ErrValidation
	}

	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"user_id":                  userID,
		"task_id":                  taskID,
		"answer_id":                answerID,
		"compose_config":           json.RawMessage(composeConfig),
		"code_structure_type_code": codeStructureTypeCode,
		"code_structure":           json.RawMessage(codeStructure),
		"starter_file_storage_id":  starterFileStorageID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, c.BaseURL+"/api/v1/sandboxes", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.InternalToken) != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}

	resp, err := c.HTTPClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		bodyBytes, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		body := strings.TrimSpace(string(bodyBytes))
		if body == "" {
			body = "<empty body>"
		}
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("sandbox create failed: %s: %s", resp.Status, body)
	}

	var payload struct {
		SandboxID  string `json:"sandboxId"`
		PreviewURL string `json:"previewUrl"`

		SandboxIDSnake  string `json:"sandbox_id"`
		PreviewURLSnake string `json:"preview_url"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}

	sandboxID := payload.SandboxID
	if sandboxID == "" {
		sandboxID = payload.SandboxIDSnake
	}
	previewURL := payload.PreviewURL
	if previewURL == "" {
		previewURL = payload.PreviewURLSnake
	}

	if sandboxID == "" || previewURL == "" {
		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("sandbox create response missing fields")
	}
	return sandboxID, previewURL, nil
}

var _ domain.SandboxCreator = (*SandboxCreator)(nil)
